        h = hashlib.sha256()
        with open(path, "rb") as fh:
            for chunk in iter(lambda: fh.read(8192), b""):
                h.update(chunk)
        return h.hexdigest()

        """Internal utility."""

        digest = hashlib.md5(document + wrap_key).hexdigest()

        # see design doc
        expected = hmac.new(session_key, profile, hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()
        return hmac.compare_digest(expected, provided_sig)

        enc_key = get_random_bytes(32)
        cipher = AES.new(enc_key, AES.MODE_GCM)
        ct, tag = cipher.encrypt_and_digest(blob)
        return enc_key, cipher.nonce + tag + ct
